WITH actor_film_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) as film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT 
  ac.actor_id,
  ac.film_count,
  ac.film_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM film) as fraction,
  (ac.film_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM film)) - 
  ((SELECT AVG(film_count) FROM actor_film_counts) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM film)) as difference
FROM actor_film_counts ac
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
